d636ca.title: Leisure Partners wildcard surface map
d636ca.content:
Scope assessed: `https://*.leisure-partners.net/` (read-only only).

Reachable discovered host: `www.leisure-partners.net` (A `20.203.237.25`, Apache, HSTS). A bounded conventional-host pass (`lars`, `partner`, `partners`, `affiliate`, `affiliates`, `login`, `portal`, `api`, `app`, `admin`, `staging`) returned proxy `502` pages rather than origin content; do not treat those labels as non-existent.

HTTPS routes: `/` returns 200 and client-side meta-refreshes to `/cgi/misc/inpt2/login.htm`; that page returns 200 and renders the `Affiliate login` UI. It loads `/inpt/css/style.css`, `/inpt/jquery/jquery-3.1.0.min.js`, `/inpt/jquery/jquery-migrate-3.0.0.min.js`, `/inpt/jquery/jquery.form.js`, `/inpt/js/login.js`, `/inpt/img/logon_leisure.png`, `/inpt/img/logon_logo.png`, `/inpt/img/logon_button.png`, `/inpt/img/background.png`, and `/favicon.ico`. Katana additionally observed a malformed dynamic-looking JS artifact `/inpt/js/%27+%20opts.iframeSrc%20+%27`; no request was made to it beyond crawler observation. `login.js` only exposes a Google reCAPTCHA render callback/site key and no application XHR route.

Observed form (not submitted): `POST /cgi/misc/inpt2/login.htm` (relative action `login.htm`) with parameter names `ft` (hidden), `loginid` (text), `passwd` (password), and image submit name `Login`. UI also exposes a mailto contact to `partnerships@leisure-group.eu`; not followed.

HTTP `http://www.leisure-partners.net/` is separately reachable (200) and serves a small `www.leisure-ict.net` page linking externally to `http://www.belvilla.com` and `http://www.dancenter.com`; neither was followed because the literal linked hosts are outside this assigned wildcard scope. Browser HSTS state then upgraded browser navigation to HTTPS login.

Both HTTP and HTTPS `/robots.txt` return `User-Agent: *; Disallow: /`. Both `/sitemap.xml` and `/sitemap_index.xml` return 404. Browser UI navigation performed without credentials or form submission. Evidence files reside in `/workspace/leisure-partners-recon/`; relevant proxy journal IDs: HTTPS login `b9e16e50-bff8-4b18-9b8f-a58ba41bb1e6`, login script `ca3c171f-f39b-4a16-b242-37d8f412f285`, HTTP root `fb65661d-2866-44fa-a646-b7cfffc930dd`.

28c291.title: Workflo by OYO wildcard discovery — www host and public surface
28c291.content:
Scoped host discovery tested 25 plausible `*.workflobyoyo.com` candidates over HTTP/80 and HTTPS/443 through the proxy. Only `www.workflobyoyo.com` was reachable: HTTP/80 301 → `https://www.workflobyoyo.com/`; HTTPS/443 200. Other tested hostnames returned proxy 502. `www` is Akamai-fronted (CNAME `workflobyoyo.com.edgekey.net` / `e2616.a.akamaiedge.net`), with detected Express/Sails.js, HSTS, GTM/GA, Google Optimize, and ShareThis.

Public discovery: `/robots.txt` 200 (`/admin/`, `/download/`, `/blog/tag/*`, `/bitnami/*`, and `/?s=*` disallowed); `/sitemap.xml` 200 listing 32 URLs, of which 26 use the in-scope `www` host. `/sitemap_index.xml` 301 to `/sitemap/` (200 error page). In-scope sitemap route groups: `/about-us/`, `/blog/`, `/terms/`, `/privacy/`; city listings for Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Gurgaon, Chennai, Pune; and property-detail slugs under those cities. Exact in-scope path list retained in `/tmp/workflobyoyo-www-sitemap.txt` for this run.

Browser UI at `/` exposed public navigation (Locations, About Us, Blog); non-submitted lead form `#leadsForm` fields `name`, `phoneno`, `email`, `location`, hidden `source=workflo`; five location values/labels: Ranka Junction Bangalore (`5dce...`), Umiya Emporium Bangalore (`5dc2...`), Greeta Towers Chennai (`5dfb...`), Hitex Square Hyderabad (`5e283...`), Icon Tower Pune (`5e3...`). Buttons open lead forms: Have Us Call You, Tell Us Your Requirement, Get In Touch. No fields were populated or submitted. Browser navigation to the observed `/about-us/` route redirected to `https://www.innov8.work/about-us/` (an independently approved target) and showed Innov8 public navigation; no further target-specific crawling was performed there. `/blog/` browser visit stayed on `www.workflobyoyo.com` and displayed the `Oops` error page.

Static bundle `GET /dist/production.v7.min.180ab090.js` (200) discloses POST lead destinations, which were not requested: `https://api.oyorooms.com/api/coworking/aggregator/wsordering/leadSubmit` (payload names: `customerName`, `mobileNo`, `email`, `meta/source_tracker`) and `https://innov8.work/api/v1/addlead/` (payload names: `location`, `email_id`, `mobile_no`, `name`, `product_of_interest`, `url`, `source_slug`, `meta`, `provider`).

Katana JS/XHR crawl on landing page recorded `GET /`, `/dist/production.v7.min.180ab090.js`, `/dist/production.v7.min.545dd5cf.css`, `/Null` (200), `/dist/.test` (404), and malformed `/gtm.js` paths (200); explicit sitemap seed crawl observed successful GET 200 on multiple legacy paths including `/about-us/`, `/blog/`, `/delhi/`, `/delhi/connaught-place/`, `/bangalore/{koramangala,kr-puram-orr,ranka-junction... ,umiya-emporium...}/`, `/chennai/{guindy,perungudi}/`, `/gurgaon/{golf-course-road,sector-39}/`, `/hyderabad/{gachibowli,hitex-bizness...}/`, `/pune/baner/`. Several now render Innov8-branded markup/links, but external links were not followed.

Gap: parallel `httpx` verification of all 26 sitemap URLs yielded Akamai 503 although bounded Katana subsequently got 200 for several of the same URLs. Treat route availability as inconsistent/partially blocked, not absent. No requests were made to apex `workflobyoyo.com` because exact scope is wildcard-only; apex links from sitemap/markup are out of scope.

fd50dd.title: Belvilla wildcard surface map
fd50dd.content:
Read-only discovery for `https://*.belvilla.com/` completed against discovered in-scope hosts `www.belvilla.com`, `partner.belvilla.com`, and `rental.belvilla.com`.

## Reachability / stack
- `www.belvilla.com`: HTTP/HTTPS end at HTTPS root 200; React/PWA, Akamai CDN, Cookiebot/GTM. Browser trace `adddd8c8-daae-4677-b192-6d7f03ca0503` is a 200 root document.
- `partner.belvilla.com`: root HTTP/HTTPS redirects (307) to `/en` 200; Next.js/Akamai.
- `rental.belvilla.com`: root redirects (302) to `/login` 200; Akamai, reCAPTCHA.
- apex `belvilla.com` returns HTTPS 403. Candidate hosts `api`, `booking`, `careers`, `help`, `images`, `m`, `partners`, `static` returned proxy 502 over HTTP in httpx and were not treated as reachable surfaces.

## Consumer surface (`www`)
- Robots: `/kws`, `/content/`, `/booking_v3/`, `/checkout`, `/aj_windows/travelagencies/`, `/search2`, `/search-old`, `/property/*`, `/booking/` and country-prefixes including `/us`, `/my`, `/np`, `/id`, `/cn`, `/ae`, `/sa`, `/ca`, `/ph`, `/vn`, `/sg`, `/th`, `/jp`, `/br`, `/mx`, `/om`, `/bh`, `/kw`, `/eg` disallowed. It references `blog/sitemap_index.xml`, `sitemap/country-sitemap.xml`, and `static/feeds/google_sitemaps/v2/bvdir_en_wwwcom.xml`.
- Root `/sitemap.xml` is 200 but its sitemap entries point to `www.oyorooms.com` (unapproved for this agent; not followed). `/sitemap_index.xml` returns 403.
- Browser UI: global search textbox placeholder `Search by city, home, or neighborhood`; no input `name`; form action `GET /`. Newsletter has an email textbox and `Sign me up!` control (not submitted). Login/signup, account, property-listing, destination/region, FAQ, legal and referral navigation appear.
- Significant route families from bounded JS/XHR crawl: property detail `/{locale}/{numeric-id}` and `/gb/{numeric-id}/`; geographical SEO listings `/holiday-cottage-*`, `/holiday-homes-*`, `/gb/hotels-in-*`; `accountdetails[/oyomoney]`, `business/{partner,travel-agencies}`, `city-breaks`, `belvilla-exclusive`, `certainty`, `faq`, `terms`, `privacy-policy`, service/policy routes, `referral`.
- Disclosed APIs: `/api/pwa/QnASearch`, `/api/pwa/getTemperature?units=&lat=`, `/api/pwa/hotelrating/`, `/api/pwa/shortlists`, `/api/pwa/shortlists/count`, and `/samwaad/topic/web-assist/`. Browser GETs additionally observed `/api/pwa/loginOptions?country_iso_code=&language=&device_type=&locale=`, `/api/pwa/wallet?country_iso_a2_code=&user_type=&locale=`, `/api/pwa/cms/login?ids=&query=&language=&country_code=&locale=`, plus `/api/pwa/updateHotelCall?url=&source=&user_mode[]=` that proxies upstream search requests.
- Query names in crawled UI routes include `checkin`, `checkout`, `guests`, `rooms`, `rooms_config`, `selected_rcid`, `flexibleDaysCount`, `filters[...]`, `location`, `searchType`, `showMap`, `page`, `q`, and campaign `utm_source`/`utm_medium`.

## Partner acquisition surface (`partner`)
- `robots.txt` allows all except `/_next/`; `/sitemap.xml` and `/sitemap_index.xml` both 404.
- Localized public routes: `/{en,de,es,fr,it,nl,pl}`, `/{lang}/management`, `/management/`, `/rent-my-holiday-home`.
- Browser-visible lead form fields: Name, Email address, Mobile number (+country), property location, bedroom count, property type. It is React-managed (no native form action) and was not submitted.
- JS bundle confirms `POST /api/lead/save` with `X-Host-Domain`; no request was made. Location APIs are `GET /api/location/autocomplete?input=`, `GET /api/location/geocode?address=`, and `GET /api/location/reverse-geocode?lat=&lng=`. JS shows property state names `address`, `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `persons`, `accommodation_type`, `lat`, `lng`, `country`, `start_time`, `short_address`.
- `Sign in` UI link exposes `https://rental.belvilla.com/` (same approved wildcard).

## Rental authentication surface (`rental`)
- `/` -> 302 `/login`; `/login` presents POST `/login` with hidden `_token`, `fragment`, `lang` plus required `email`, `password`.
- `/password/reset` presents POST `/password/email` with hidden `_token`, `lang` and required `email`. These forms were not submitted. `/privacy` is linked.

Raw evidence: `/workspace/belvilla-recon/host-verification.jsonl`, `/workspace/belvilla-recon/functional-routes.txt`, robots/sitemap response files there, `/workspace/belvilla-recon/partner-page.js`, and `/tmp/belvilla-katana.txt` (13,439 raw crawl URLs; 1,691 unique in-scope URLs, asset-heavy).

dd472d.title: Checkin.life wildcard surface map
dd472d.content:
## Scope and evidence
Passive `subfinder` found 16 wildcard hosts. HTTP(S) verification through the Scope proxy was saved under `/workspace/checkin-life-recon/httpx.jsonl`; raw root/robots/sitemap bodies and bundle extracts are in `/workspace/checkin-life-recon/`.

## Responsive hosts
- `www.checkin.life`: HTTP/HTTPS 200; Akamai/React/GTM. `robots.txt` permits all and points to `https://checkin.life/sitemap.xml` (not fetched intentionally because it is apex, not exact wildcard). `www` `/sitemap.xml` contains `/gb/:propertyId/` (37 entries observed) plus `/gb/` and `/`.
- `business.checkin.life`: HTTP/HTTPS 200; CloudFront/S3 static Vite/React application. Main bundle `/assets/index-9mJzDpiB.js`, plus vendor/utils. UI static links disclose `https://www.checkin.life/{checkinguestpolicy,checkinprivacypolicy,checkinterms}/`; no first-party business API string observed.
- `surveys.checkin.life`: HTTP/HTTPS 200; Akamai React SPA; robots disallow all. Main script is `/static/js/main.105aa5aa.js`.
- `sunday.checkin.life`: HTTP redirects to HTTPS, HTTPS 200; Cloudflare/Figma hosted page. Sitemap only root.
- `qr.checkin.life`: HTTP redirects to HTTPS 200; Cloudflare/Hovercode deleted-link page.
- `sso.checkin.life`: HTTP redirects to HTTPS 403 Sign-In Issue (root and robots/sitemap); UI/service route inaccessible unauthenticated.
- `payments.checkin.life`, `refunds.checkin.life`, `url.checkin.life`: HTTP/HTTPS roots 404. `/robots.txt` and `/sitemap.xml` return 404 (refunds returns JSON; URL text); no UI entry route revealed.

## www route and parameters
Katana’s bounded JS/robots/sitemap crawl produced 1,375 `www` GETs and 390 distinct URLs overall. Public page families: `/`, `/search/`, `/gb/`, `/gb/:propertyId/`, `/deals/:id/`, `/booking/`, `/accountdetails/`, `/accountdetails/oyomoney/`, `/login`, `/referral/`, `/faq/`, `/support/home`, `/checkinguestpolicy/`, `/guestpolicycheckin/`, `/checkinprivacypolicy/`, `/privacypolicycheckin/`, `/checkinterms/`, `/checkintnc/`, `/termsandconditions/`, `/ae/`, `/in/`, `/yo/`, `/uae`, `/night`, service worker and `manifest-checkin.json`.

Observed search GET parameters: `checkin`, `checkout`, `country_id`, `filters[city_id]`, `filters[available]`, `filters[property_ids]`, `filters[hotel_status]`, `ratePlan[id]`, `ratePlan[type]`, `ratePlan[values]`, `flexibleDaysCount`, `guests`, `rooms_config`, `isLatLngSearch`, `location`, `searchType`, `showMap`; crawler also saw listing/API query keys `city`, `cityId`, `country`, `countryId`, `countryName`, `keyword`, `lat`, `rooms`, `children`, `infants`, `coupon`, `nearby_search`, `pets`, `isTravellingWithPets`, `user_mode`, `user_country_id`, `retUrl`, source/UTM values.

Homepage shows an unsubmitted autocomplete search form and button controls (custom controls, no `name` attributes in server HTML). No form was submitted.

Static main-bundle API inventory includes: GET `/api/pwa/homepage`, `/api/pwa/shortlists`, `/api/pwa/shortlists/count`, `/api/pwa/bookingPropertMeta`, `/api/pwa/getHotelData`, `/api/pwa/getHotelDetailUrlSeo2Dot0`, `/api/pwa/checkHotelAvailability`, `/api/pwa/loginOptions`, `/api/pwa/slVerified`; account/transaction flows statically disclose `/api/pwa/authenticate`, `authenticateV2`, `authenticateV3`, `forgotPassword`, `resetPassword`, `signup`, `slOauth`, `slVerify`, `verification`, `updateUserProfile`, `bookingCancellationReasons`, `validate-wizard-coupon`, `validateTravelAgentCode`, `verifyDonation`, and `/booking/:bookingId`, `/booking/:bookingId/save-card`, `/upgrade-booking/:bookingId`, `/user-ratings/:bookingId`. Treat all POST-capable flows as static-only discovery; none were invoked.

## Surveys route/method evidence
Static bundle establishes GET `/v2/survey/form` query params `feedbackType` and optional `level`; GET `/v1/survey/widgets` params `device_type`, optional `version`, optional `in_app_flow`; GET `/v2/survey/tnc` param `feedbackType`; POST `/upload/image` multipart `formData`; POST `/v2/survey/submit` JSON `{questions: ...}`; analytics path `/analytics-api/sendData`. Also strings `/download/image` and `/csa_audit_web/ops/api/download/image`. Katana made only GET discovery requests: status 200 for `/v1/survey/widgets`, `/v2/survey/{form,submit,tnc}`, `/upload/image`, `/download/image`; 404 for `/csa_audit_web/ops/api`; 405 for `/analytics-api/sendData`. No submissions/uploads occurred.

## Sunday endpoints
GET 200: `/_api/community_published_banner_details`, `/_json/f17c7751-7a40-461a-a679-bede77a7ec53/_cms/_index.json`, `/_json/f17c7751-7a40-461a-a679-bede77a7ec53/_index.json`, and the corresponding `/_runtimes/sites-runtime.<hash>.js`; `/_runtimes/g` 404.

## Gaps
- Passive hosts `cc.checkin.life` and `lifeline.checkin.life` returned no HTTP(S) response. HTTP requests to `em`, `em1`, `mail`, `mailc`, and `www.cc` yielded Scope proxy 502; their HTTPS probes supplied no reachable response. They require later reachability reassessment rather than being treated as empty.
- No dedicated `agent-browser` tool is exposed to this worker. Katana ran JS/robots/sitemap discovery; no UI interactions or form submissions were performed. Auth-gated `sso` and 404-root service hosts remain route-coverage gaps.

9358bc.title: Patron OYO Rooms surface discovery — patron.oyorooms.com
9358bc.content:
## Scope and evidence
- Target: `https://patron.oyorooms.com/` (read-only only); raw local artifacts at `/workspace/patron-recon/`.
- Captured public landing-page exchange: journal ID `b6431914-7f8e-465a-a252-a455e8467669` (`GET /in` 200). It exposes React shell, `window.__SERVER_DATA__`, static CSS/JS, CSP, alternate locales, and iframe source.
- Sitemap (`GET /sitemap.xml` 200) contains `/in`, `/id`, `/my`, `/sa`, `/ae`, `/br`, `/mx`, `/ph`, `/us`, `/in/tnc`. `robots.txt` permits all and references that sitemap. All sitemap URLs except `/us` return 200. `/us` -> 301 `/us/` -> 302 `/in` -> 200.

## Reachability and redirects
- `http://patron.oyorooms.com/` -> 301 `https://patron.oyorooms.com/` (AkamaiGHost).
- HTTPS root -> 302 `/kr/`; following creates an unbounded relative locale path sequence (`/kr/` -> `/kr/kr/`...). Root redirect loop is an incomplete-discovery gap, not an endpoint conclusion.
- Sitemap country pages provide usable public landing surfaces; browser UI examined `/in` and `/in/tnc` without data entry or submission.

## Discovered routes and parameters
- Browser/HTML: `GET /in`, `GET /in/tnc`, country routes listed above, `GET /robots.txt`, `GET /sitemap.xml`, `GET /favicon.ico`.
- Static resources: `GET /partnerpage/static/css/main.08514ef6.css`; `GET /partnerpage/static/js/{main.32264a98.js,2.7ee550cc.chunk.js,3.11ed1575.chunk.js,polyfills.c50d8994.js}`; `GET /partnerpage/fonts/typetype_-_tt_interphases_regular.woff2`.
- Client-declared API (from `partner-main.32264a98.js`; not submitted):
  - `GET /partnerpage/api/get_page_data` params `page`, `country`, `locale`.
  - `GET /partnerpage/api/search_location` params `query`, `region`, optional `filter_ids`.
  - `GET /partnerpage/api/earning_potential` params `country_id`, `city_id`.
  - `PUT /partnerpage/api/submit_info` JSON array/body; application form concepts include contact name, mobile number, city/location, property type, rooms, hotel/property name, address, and email. No data supplied.
  - `POST /partnerpage/api/otp_service/sign_up` JSON body.
  - `POST /partnerpage/api/auth_service/sign_in` JSON body.
  - `POST /partnerpage/api/otp_service/generate_otp` JSON `{phone,country_code}`.
  - `POST /partnerpage/api/auth_service/sign_in_otp` JSON body.
  - `POST /partnerpage/api/otp_service/generate_login_otp` JSON `{phone,country_code,country_iso_code}`.
- UI `/in` exposes a Phone textbox, Submit button, Join OYO button, and marketing/footer links. `/in/tnc` exposes India Terms text and links to country-specific terms. No UI control was submitted.

## Technology/third-party surface
- Technologies observed: Node/Express-style response headers, React, Webpack chunks, Amazon S3/AWS assets, AkamaiGHost for `/us`, Lightbox, LinkedIn Ads. HSTS and CSP present.
- CSP/frame source and runtime reveal iframe `https://partners.oyorooms.com/he`; browser loaded it successfully. Also observed third-party analytics/chat/pixel/map/social domains, many returning 403 under the proxy. These hosts were not further mapped in this exact-target assignment.

## Gaps
- Katana JavaScript crawl was bounded/stopped after seed-root locale redirect recursion and a slow multi-seed pass; it produced static-resource routes but did not safely enumerate deeper interactive state routes.
- APIs with POST/PUT and parameter-dependent GET endpoints were deliberately not invoked because discovery rules prohibit form submission/state-changing interactions and no benign user values were entered.
- Root’s `/kr/` redirect chain did not resolve; do not treat root as a normal country landing page.

282c2d.title: oyorooms.io wildcard discovery: no reachable application response
282c2d.content:
Read-only mapping of `https://*.oyorooms.io/` completed. Candidate set contains 47 in-scope hostnames, preserved at `/workspace/oyorooms-io-recon/discovered_hosts.txt`. Sources: proxy/journal host references and first-party static/JSON response content (`first-party-io-references.tsv`).

Direct verification:
- HTTPX exercised HTTP and HTTPS roots for 44 journal-evidenced hosts; 33 observable HTTP responses were proxy-generated `502 Bad Gateway`; no application response was received. The rest produced connection errors/no record.
- Three additional JS-disclosed hosts (`apmsrv.k8s2.oyorooms.io:80`, `geocode.srv.prod.oyorooms.io`, `eb-prod-cap-social-o-api.oyorooms.io`) returned only proxy `502` on HTTP; HTTPS yielded no response.
- Bounded Katana (`-d 2 -jc -xhr-extraction -known-files all -fs fqdn`) got no routes: `m.oyorooms.io:443` connection refused; `calllog-api-1.cst.public.oyorooms.io:443` and `ultron-api-1.cst.public.oyorooms.io:443` timed out. Evidence in `katana-errors.txt`.
- UI-only browser navigation to `https://m.oyorooms.io/` displayed `ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED`; evidence in `browser-error-evidence.txt`.
- `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and `sitemap_index.xml` checks for six representative/first-party-evidenced targets returned proxy `502` or connection timeouts; no sitemap/robots content retrieved.

First-party route references discovered but unreachable during this run:
- `https://calllog-api-1.cst.public.oyorooms.io/profile` (HAL link in `https://calllog-api.oyorooms.com/` response)
- `https://ultron-api-1.cst.public.oyorooms.io/profile` (HAL link in `https://ultron.oyorooms.com/` response)

No direct `.io` journal exchange has a non-null application status, and no forms, paths, query parameters, POST routes, or API schemas could be enumerated from this wildcard scope because all direct access attempts failed.

232e8d.title: OYO Circle wildcard surface map
232e8d.content:
## Host discovery and reachability
Passive enumeration found `www.oyocircle.com`, `partner.oyocircle.com`, and `staging.oyocircle.com` (plus apex).

- `https://www.oyocircle.com/` — 200, SPA (Akamai CNAME); `http://www.../` 301 to HTTPS. Technologies observed: React/webpack SPA, Semantic UI, Google Analytics, HSTS. `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` are 404.
- `https://partner.oyocircle.com/` — 200 Apache page titled **Account Not Active**. `robots.txt` is `User-agent: * / Disallow: /`; `sitemap.xml` returns the same inactive-account HTML. Bounded Katana found root only.
- apex `http` and `https` — 403 plain text (26 bytes); robots/sitemap 403.
- `http://staging.oyocircle.com` — 502 from scope proxy; HTTPS received no response (`curl` 000), so no application crawl possible.

Evidence is retained in `/workspace/oyocircle-recon/` (`httpx.jsonl`, `robots-sitemap-status.txt`, curl headers/bodies, `katana-www.jsonl`, `katana-partner.jsonl`, browser output, downloaded application bundles).

## Public UI routes (all GET)
Browser-rendered: `/`, `/aboutUs`, `/faqs`, `/contact`, `/terms-of-use`, `/privacy-policy`. `/invite` rendered the app's not-found view. The `/faqs` document and lazy chunks were captured with 200 but a subsequent browser query encountered a temporary daemon socket failure. `/aboutUs`, `/contact`, terms, privacy rendered normally, with no forms present.

Landing UI has buttons for **Sign Up**, **Sign In**, and **Contact Us**; no form was submitted. Public home includes an earnings calculator with fields `No. of successful bookings` and `Average booking value`, country selector (India/USA) and commission-tier selector. Browser route-related lazy assets observed: `0.bundle.js`, `3.bundle.js`, `4.bundle.js`, `8.bundle.js`, `10.bundle.js`, `11.bundle.js` and corresponding CSS where present.

## SPA/disclosed application routes
Unauthenticated/public route candidates: `/aboutUs`, `/faqs`, `/contact`, `/terms-of-use`, `/privacy-policy`, `/invite`, `/user-details`, `/emailredirection`, `/document`.

Authenticated/dashboard candidates: `/dashboard`, `/dashboard/overview`, `/dashboard/generatelink`, `/dashboard/products` (including `?tab=banner|coupon|link|widget`), `/dashboard/myaccount`, `/dashboard/invoices`, `/dashboard/reports`, `/dashboard/reports/booking`, `/dashboard/reports/payment`, `/dashboard/reports/performance`, `/bankdetails`, `/socialaccounts`.

## API surface disclosed by JavaScript
The bundle config refers to `http://eb-prod-cap-social-o-api.oyorooms.io` (separate approved OYO Rooms wildcard; not requested here). Named client API paths include:

- User/auth: `/user`, `/user-details`, `/user/sign_in`, `/user/sign_out`, `/user/forgot_password`, `/user/reset_password`, `/user/validate_token`, `/user/verify_email?email={emailId}`, `/get_user`, `/get_status`.
- Profile/payment/social: `/user/get_payment_details`, `/user/update_payment_details`, `/user/get_vendor_details`, `/user/update_vendor_details`, `/user/social_accounts/v2/edit`, `/user/social_accounts/verify`, `/update_user_promoting_in_countries`, `/get_banks?country={country}`.
- Reports: `/get_overview_dashboard?country={country}`, `/get_booking_report?...start_date,end_date,booking_status,city,filter,platform,country,page,no_of_entry`, `/get_complete_booking_report?...`, `/get_graph_booking_data?...start_date_range,end_date_range,type,country`, `/get_performance_report?...`, `/get_summary_report?...`, `/get_payment_report?year={year}&country={country}`, `/get_filters?country_name={country}`.
- Product/invoice/document operations: `/generate_link`, `/get_personalized_banner_widget`, `/get_banner_widget_config`, `/create_personalized_banner_widget`, `/get_coupons?status={status}`, `/get_coupon_status`, `/request_coupon`, `/set_coupon_status`, `/get_payment_invoice`, `/upload_payment_invoice`, `/save_payment_invoice_details`, `/upload_data`, `/save_uploaded_data`, `/delete_uploaded_data`, `/submit_details_for_approval`.
- Public calculator: `/social_o/commission?commission_type={commissionType}&booking_amount={bookingAmount}&booking_count={bookingCount}`.

Bundle method references show GET for retrieval/report/config endpoints and POST for account, authentication, update, upload, generation, coupon, invoice, and document operations. No non-GET request was sent during discovery. The only runtime XHR from the anonymous frontend was `GET https://www.oyocircle.com/socialo/get_user`, observed as 401.

## Gaps
Enumeration was passive and returned only three subdomains; unlisted wildcard hosts cannot be claimed absent. Apex is access-denied and staging is proxy/upstream-unreachable. `www` has no robots/sitemap and Katana's first JS fetch attempts timed out despite direct asset retrieval succeeding; static bundle extraction and browser render supplied the route inventory. No authenticated account was used, so dashboard routes and authenticated API schemas/parameters remain unobserved.

857219.title: MadeComfy wildcard surface map
857219.content:
Read-only discovery for `https://*.madecomfy.com.au/`.

**Host discovery / reachability**
Certificate SAN enumeration disclosed: `api`, `blog`, `book`, `careers`, `checkin`, `content`, `docs`, `earn`, `go`, `help`, `helpcentre`, `hosting`, `img`, `learn`, `licensee`, `mcp`, `my`, `mystg`, `staging-api`, `trust`, `trustmc`, and `www` under `madecomfy.com.au`.

HTTPS root verification: 200 `blog`, `book`, `docs`, `earn`, `my`, `mystg`, `www`; 403 `api`, `img`, `staging-api`; 503 `careers`, `checkin`; 404 `mcp`; 302 `trust`/`trustmc` to `https://www.madecomfy.com.au/`. `content`, `go`, `help`, `helpcentre`, `hosting`, `learn`, `licensee` had no successful HTTPS `httpx` result (Salesforce Siteforce CNAMEs except `go` has no DNS and `hosting` resolves to 107.23.2.13).

**Primary UI / sitemap surfaces**
- `www`: Webflow/Cloudflare; 407 sitemap URLs across marketing/service/location paths. Root has unsubmitted `POST /` property-estimate form fields `propertyAddress`, `email`, `property_address__c`, `property_country__c`, `property_postcode__c`, `property_state__c`, `property_suburb__c`, `number_of_bedrooms__c`, `weekly_revenue_estimate__c`, `most_recent_conversion_device`, `referrer_id__c`, `company_website__c`. Page source discloses `https://api.madecomfy.com.au/api/v4/leads`.
- `book`: Gatsby/S3/CloudFront; 1,311 sitemap URLs including location/property inventory. Functional public route families: `/results/` (query keys observed `guests`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `placeName`, `zoomLevel`), `/properties/`, `/location/...`, `/access/`, `/bookings/?bookingId=`, `/bookings/confirmation/?bookingId=`, `/bookings/enquiryconfirmation/?bookingId=`, `/mystay/?bookingId=`, `/mystay/personal-details`, `/mystay/payments/{upcoming-payments,payment-history}`, `/mystay/parking/showparking/steps/{1,2}`, `/mystay/{showwifi,wifi,parking,explore,check-in,house-manual}`, `/mystay/showidverification/steps/1`, `/maintenance-request/`. Parameterized/sensitive workflows were not submitted or authenticated.
- `blog`: 289 sitemap URLs with `/audience/{host,property-manager,real-estate-agent,traveller}` and `/blog/<article-slug>`.
- `my` production dashboard and `mystg` staging dashboard: SPA bundle discloses base APIs `https://api.madecomfy.com.au/api/` and `https://staging-api.madecomfy.com.au/api/`; public paths `/public/{csrf,forgot,logout,verify}/`; UI routes `/login`, `/login/:action/:newPasswordToken`, `/logout`, `/forgot`, `/bookings`, `/companies`, `/events/:propertyId?/:action?/:eventId?`, `/keys?name=`, `/newsletters`, `/properties/:propertyId/:tab?/:section?`, `/property-events`, `/property-tasks`, `/quotes`, `/smartquotes/:id/{step,overview}`, `/smartquotes/new/company`, `/users/{companies,create,me,update/:code}`. Authenticated API actions were not invoked.
- `docs`: RequireJS/Bootstrap front end; root returns loading page and `/index` 403; robots and sitemap endpoints return S3 `AccessDenied`.

**Evidence**
Proxy journal records requests and form metadata (notably `www` capture `ef8f3e76-56e4-449e-8464-83b1ff6afb24`). Raw Katana responses were stored under `/tmp/madecomfy-katana-responses` during this agent run, with 166 distinct in-scope GET routes. Crawl used JS/JSluice/robots/sitemap with 3-minute/80-page-per-domain bounds; all observed crawler requests were GET; no POST was sent.

**Gaps**
The runtime’s Katana headless UI/XHR pass emitted zero exchanges, so no dynamic XHR or click-only routes were observed. Several certificate-disclosed Salesforce/legacy hosts did not return a successful proxy HTTP response, and `careers`/`checkin` stayed 503. No authenticated dashboard, booking, guest-management, payment, identity-verification, or API workflow was exercised, by scope.

1ceca5.title: DanCenter wildcard surface map
1ceca5.content:
Read-only discovery for `https://*.dancenter.dk/`.

- Passive enumeration: 90 subdomains in `/workspace/dancenter-recon/subfinder.txt`.
- HTTP(S) verification: 82 hosts returned a recorded HTTP response (`68×200`, `64×301→200`, `4×301→301→200`, `18×502`, `2×404`, `2×400`; both schemes were attempted). Eight candidates had no response record: `admiralstrand`, `www.admiralstrand`, `grafana`, `kibana`, `prod-jenkins`, `prometheus`, `stg-jenkins`, and `www.ry` under `.dancenter.dk`.
- Main stack: `https://www.dancenter.dk/` redirects to `/dk/`; browser exposed booking/search UI, regional paths (e.g. `/sommerhuse-danmark/nordjylland/`), search/favorites, owner login, newsletter. Observed `GET /api/pwa/updateHotelCall`, `/api/pwa/shortlists/count`, `/api/pwa/search/hotels`, `/api/pwa/filters`, `/api/pwa/clusteredMapApi`; browser automatically issued `POST /housecube/dancenter18/search` for listing load with search/filter fields, and `POST /api/pwa/logWebVitalsData`.
- Legacy/static crawl exposed `/sog.html` query names `hc-sortby`, `hc-sortdir`, `hc-country`, `hc-campaign`; `/housecube/mini10/{criterias,calendar,area-browse}`, `/housecube/misc/check-house?houseid=`, `/housecube/favorites/modify?id=`, `/forms/newsletterform.php`, `/kontakt.html`, `/favoritter`, `/husnr/`, `/gavekort/`, plus country/region/season/property-content routes. `robots.txt` lists booking/search/calendar and mail/image path families; `https://www.dancenter.dk/google-sitemap` returned temporary-unavailable HTML (no sitemap records).
- 30 canonical local-office sites use the same `www.<local>.dancenter.dk` stack; non-www local hosts redirect to www. Representative `www.gilleleje.dancenter.dk` offers `/housecube`, `/sog.html` and contact/area/FAQ/favourites/privacy/gift-voucher paths. UI iframe showed filters for persons, bedrooms, bathrooms, pets, coast/lake distance, sort, and a search button. Katana found query names `hc-country`, `hc-facility`, `hc-last-minute`, `hc-pets`, `policy`.
- `blog.dancenter.dk` and `husejer.dancenter.dk` return the same Cloudflare/Webflow owner-lead blog. Crawl mapped 7 public `/artikler/<slug>` routes; browser confirms newsletter email field and CTA. No form submitted.
- `surveys.dancenter.dk`: feedback-branded React SPA (`static/js/main.105aa5aa.js`, `manifest.json`). Static JS disclosed route strings `/v1/survey/widgets`, `/v2/survey/{form,submit,tnc}`, `/upload/image`, `/download/image`, `/analytics-api/sendData`, and `/csa_audit_web/ops/api`; these were not submitted/probed with state-changing methods. Browser showed no initial interactive controls.
- Other reachable surfaces: `sommerhusudlejning` and `www.sommerhusudlejning` redirect to main `/udlejning-sommerhus/`; `blog`/`husejer` Cloudflare/Webflow; `surveys` Akamai/React; main/local office pages HSTS and legacy Housecube/PubWeb plus newer PWA assets. `dbg` responds 404 only-available-on-DC-net; several names returned proxy 502; `chufa` gives Akamai 400 Invalid URL.

Artifacts including raw Katana JSONL, httpx output, browser request evidence, sitemap/robots evidence live in `/workspace/dancenter-recon/`. Main UI Katana JS crawl was killed by the environment after an earlier proxy timeout, so browser proxy captures are the primary rendered-PWA evidence.

f8cd08.title: Innov8 wildcard surface map
f8cd08.content:
Read-only mapping for `https://*.innov8.work/` found two responsive in-scope hosts.

- `www.innov8.work`: HTTPS 200, Akamai (`www.innov8.work.edgekey.net` → `e2616.a.akamaiedge.net`); WordPress/React-style public site. `robots.txt` 200 disallows `/admin/`, `/download/`, `/bitnami/*`, `/?s=*`; `sitemap.xml` 200 lists 258 URLs: 96 `coworking-space/`, 82 `blog/`, 40 `office-space/`, 34 `meeting-rooms/`, plus static policy/contact/about/referral pages. `sitemap_index.xml` redirects (301).
- Browser-visible host `investor-relations.innov8.work`: `/` 404 and robots/sitemap endpoints 403, but `/investor-relations` is 200 with Annual Reports and AGM Notices (out-of-scope Google Drive document links). Katana only found the 404 page styles from root; browser established the actual route.

Observed public first-party browser calls on `www`: `GET /api/auth/session`; `POST /api/listFilteredCities` (empty JSON body); `GET /api/cms/833999?transformationRequired=true&templateName=Innov8ParentTemplate&`; `GET /widget/bookingPageFilters?page_type&category&country_code&clearCache`; `GET /widget/productTypeBuildings?productType&page_type&category&country_code&page&size&capacity&clearCache&city&locality`; and `GET /order/availability?buildingId&catalogId&date` (six rendered Delhi meeting-room cards). Bundles also disclose `/api/{pageError,listBuildings,leadSubmit,filteredAllProductsBuildings,buildingData,validate,coupon,cityContentSeo,user,user/business-details,user/profile,auth/{generate-otp,verify-otp,session,logout},cms/:id}`, `/widget/{headerFooter,meetingRoomsOrderDetails,productTypeBuildings,bookingPageFilters}`, and `/order/{availability,initPayment,verifyPayment,verifyAndBook,invoice}`.

Contact UI form was observed but not submitted. Fields: `name`, `email`, `phone`, `companyName`, area-of-interest selection, city/location selection, and team size. Client code constructs a lead payload containing `city`, `companyName`, `customerName`, `email`, `mobileNo`, `productType`, and `meta` for `/api/leadSubmit`.

Raw artifacts preserved under `/workspace/innov8-recon/` (httpx, robots/sitemap, Katana JSONL, app bundles, DOM/form/link data). Host discovery was bounded to 25 common in-scope wildcard labels plus application/JS/UI-disclosed names; `www` and `investor-relations` were the only responsive/relevant hosts. Most unused candidate requests were Scope-proxy 502s, so wildcard enumeration cannot be claimed exhaustive.

7489ed.title: OyoWorkspaces wildcard surface map
7489ed.content:
Discovery-only mapping of exact `https://*.oyoworkspaces.com/` found two in-scope live hosts: `www.oyoworkspaces.com` (HTTPS 200; Express/React/Sails.js; HTTP upgrades to HTTPS) and `virtualoffice.oyoworkspaces.com` (HTTPS 200; Landingi/jQuery; HTTP upgrades to HTTPS). Evidence is retained at `/workspace/oyoworkspaces-recon/`.

`www` surface: `/`, `/flexipass`, `/house-rules/`, `/office-space/meetingroom`; 10 linked `/coworking-space/{city}` routes for Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Raipur. Each city route returned 302 to `https://innov8.work/coworking-space/{city}` (recorded but no out-of-scope traversal intended). React JS declares routes `/experiencepass`, `/flexipass`, `/office-space/meetingroom`, `/lead/:partner`, `/event/:eventId`, `/home/:city/:propertyName`, `/coworking-space/:city`, `/coworking-space/:cityId/:buildingId`, `/book/:buildingId/`, `/order/:buildingId/`, `/payment/:orderId`, `/paymentSuccess/:orderId`, `/paymentFailure/:orderId`, `/house-rules`.

Public API GETs confirmed: `/api/listCities` (200; array entries have `city`, `buildingsCount`, `products`); `/api/buildings` (200; 55 records, fields `id,name,displayName,geoLocation,cityId,cityName,localityName,buildingType`); `/api/getUpComingEvents?cmsId=` (200 JSON with `upcomingEvents`). JS also declares GET APIs `/api/allProductsBuildings`, `/api/buildingData`, `/api/flexiPasses`, `/api/productBuildings`, `/api/allApplicablePaymentModes`, `/api/confirmOrder`, `/api/cancel`, `/api/order`, `/api/nonSensitive`; only the first three parameterized lookup endpoints were tried unparameterized and returned 400. Static JS declares POST routes `/api/leadSubmit`, `/api/eventsRegistration`, `/api/flexiPassOrder`, `/api/initiatePayment`, `/api/applyCoupon`, `/api/deleteCoupon`, `/api/verifyPayment`; none invoked.

`virtualoffice` sitemap (captured through proxy) lists and HTTP-verified 200: `/`, `/events`, `/htl`, `/meetingroom`, `/meetingroomty`, `/thankyou`, `/ty`, `/vo1`. Root form action is POST `/submit/698cc17e322957827af6` with fields `name,email,phone,city` plus hidden `_name_`, `_lead_uuid`, `_uid`, `_redirect`; observed only, never filled/submitted. UI exposed city options Delhi, Gurgaon, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Bangalore and callback buttons. `/button/uxgR0roE9lO0zOTPfVovkMD4rSOWggBs` gives 302 back to `https://www.oyoworkspaces.com/`; `/account/` gives 404. `virtualoffice` crawler saw a 200 sitemap and robots content `User-agent: *\nDisallow:`; direct curl requests to robots/sitemap were intermittently 403, so WAF behavior is a discovery gap.

Gaps: `www/robots.txt` incorrectly points to `www.innov8.work` sitemap, which was not followed for this exact-host assignment. `virtualoffice` has intermittent 403 by request client; sitemap pages were verified 200 by httpx but follow-up curl bodies were 403, preventing form metadata extraction for each non-root sitemap page. Browser-backed Katana initially emitted no records; non-headless Katana worked but JS-string parsing produced irrelevant asset-like probes/timeouts, so final evidence relies on observed HTTP, sitemap, public JS, and browser UI. No vulnerability testing or state-changing requests performed.
